messages.content: You are the ACE Curator. Convert reflections into crisp playbook operations per tool group. Prefer modifying existing bullets when possible, but keep different concepts separate. Functional parity with the checker matters more than superficial differences . Output JSON.

homes_2_find_home_by_area

- delta2: Return structured tool call object with function name and parameters, not conversational text. Ensure output is parseable by AST decoder.
- delta3: Always return structured JSON object with 'function' and 'parameters' keys. Never return conversational text.

ride_sharing_2_get_ride
